Required top-level architecture wiring for ARCH=um SUBARCH=arm64.
Darwin host services behind the established UML host-OS boundary.
Kernel-side standard device semantics stay in Linux; only Darwin host services belong in outer providers, as recorded in extraction-decisions.tsv.
Linux-host parity changes required by shared SMP and host-service abstractions.
Shared UML architecture hooks, MMU, SMP, and page-size support.
Virtio-GPU must retire atomic scanout state while the device remains usable during system shutdown.
The standard host-visible blob allocator must honor the 16 KiB Apple host mapping granule for both supported guest page profiles.
The standard fbcon selection must avoid UML's legacy stdio-console major only when that driver is configured.
The central cond_resched boundary polls cooperative Darwin timer deadlines under an architecture guard before checking the reschedule request they produce.
Kbuild host tools run before the outer emulator exists, so their ELF portability remains in this local line; see extraction-decisions.tsv.
